name: Md. Jubayer Hossain Abir
headline: I build systems, not just features.
lead: Full-stack engineer working across backend architecture, API design, database performance and production infrastructure — from system design through to deployment and the troubleshooting that follows.
experienceSummary: Close to five years building production software across telecom messaging, microfinance, fleet and HR systems.

portrait.alt: Portrait of Md. Jubayer Hossain Abir
portrait.caption: Dhaka, Bangladesh

about: I work on the parts of a product that have to keep running: the API that absorbs the traffic, the schema that still answers quickly once the table is large, the deployment that survives a bad night. Most of what I have built has been for organisations where a failure is somebody's payroll, loan disbursement or delivery schedule.

I lead development on Conneczen, an A2P SMS aggregation platform where the engineering problem is sustained throughput and provider reliability rather than features. Alongside it I work as a senior developer on Microzen, a microfinance system whose approval workflows have to model real organisational hierarchies — a harder modelling problem than it first appears.

I like being the person who can take a business requirement through the whole path — design the backend, model the data, build the interface, deploy it, and then fix it when production disagrees with the plan.

education.degree: B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering
